original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Repair registered-package blob validation on Git without cat-file --batch -z, preserving exact provenance and live-input checks.
scope_change_reason: Expertise override from picker suggestions bit-new-register-model and bit-helper-contract after live overlap review. The portable-replay card is refined to the documented older-Git failure in PR2721 and the merged P104 side-correction obstruction package.
bottleneck_link: A Git option failure prevents source-pin validation before mathematical replay. This is verifier portability work, not a supplier or exponent improvement.
stop_rule: Stop after real Git 2.34.1 and 2.47.3 accept the same package pins and exact-byte/failure/cleanup tests pass; do not modify scientific inputs or broaden into other Git compatibility work.
evidence: Original package --check-only failed on Git 2.34.1 with unknown switch z and passes after the fix. Ten new behavioral tests, the existing Git batch tests, 80 research tests on both Git versions and the frozen pin-batching controls pass. See README.md for commands and limitations.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Substantial assistance was used for implementation, tests and documentation; no independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Do other contributor Git versions reject a distinct command used by the package tools?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A validated runner does not guarantee every package command is portable.
open_questions.first_step: Run one affected package on the reported version and isolate the first failing command, retaining exact source pins.
open_questions.blocked_by: No additional reproduced failure is assigned here; do not infer broader compatibility from two tested versions.

assignment.override_reason: Concrete documented environment failure and a bounded verifier-engineering contribution; overlapping bit mechanism work was not duplicated.

overlap.limitation: Bodies, comments, package notes and ledger only, not every code diff. Targeted PR2721 and Discussion2684 were read live.

freshness.compatibility: Canonical main advanced without changes to guidance, selected record, runner or retained Git tests; frozen scientific baseline remains the starting commit.

submission_overlap.matches: Only this package, the original batching note and the documented failure reports; body/comment search is not a code-diff novelty certificate.

coordination: Read Start here, active discussions, the handoff hub and the PR2721 investigation. No advance claim was posted; this is a completed tooling repair, not a reservation or a mathematical claim.
